title: /ultraplan — Cloud-Based Interactive Planning with Browser Review
description: New /ultraplan command (research preview, v2.1.91+) hands a planning task from the local CLI to a Claude Code web session. Plan drafts in the cloud while terminal stays free. In the browser, users can leave inline comments on specific plan sections, emoji-react, iterate with Claude, then either: (A) execute on the web and open a PR, or (B) teleport the approved plan back to the local terminal. 'Teleport back' injects the plan into the current conversation or starts a fresh session. Triggered via /ultraplan command, the keyword 'ultraplan' in any prompt, or 'Refine with Ultraplan' when declining a local plan. Requires claude.ai account + GitHub repo. Complementary to /ultrareview — plan first, review last.
redundancy_check: NOVEL — local plan mode is terminal-only single-pass; this is cloud-hosted with browser review interface, section-level inline comments, and two-way sync
version_introduced: v2.1.91+ (research preview, documented in v2.1.111 changelog)
limitations: Research preview, requires claude.ai account + GitHub repo, not available on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry.

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic feature (community_validation=100), Anthropic-maintained (maintenance=100). Integration is low-friction — triggered by /ultraplan command or keyword, requires existing claude.ai auth + GitHub repo (complexity=75). Token efficiency positive (65): off-loads planning work to cloud session, keeping local terminal context budget free during planning phase. Capability expansion high (80): browser-based inline comment review, section-level annotation, and bidirectional plan teleport are genuinely novel — terminal plan mode has none of these collaboration features. Three trigger modes (explicit /ultraplan, keyword, decline-and-refine) provide seamless local↔cloud workflow. Integration action: registry entry + note in Plan Mode Quality CLAUDE.md section documenting /ultraplan as complement to local plan mode.
